issue.title: Bug: `setup_acl_table` in everflow ipv6 tests should use `wait_for_acl_rules_in_asic_db` rather than custom `wait_until`

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

Currently there is a `wait_until` on `validate_acl_rules_in_asic_db` with a fixed timeout in `setup_acl_table` fixture. Instead it should use common function `wait_for_acl_rules_in_asic_db` which will respect defined everflow plt wait time.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run tests on switch that may take longer than 120 to sync ACL to ASIC DB

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

`setup_acl_table` should respect defined PLT everflow wait time (via `wait_for_acl_rules_in_asic_db` common function)
